title: 40% off Amazon Haul Items + Delivery @ Amazon Haul
body:
Deal: 40% off Amazon Haul Items + Delivery @ Amazon Haul

[BestTechAdvisor] Ironically, I can find better quality products at my local landfill.
[jackary] Oooh, that’s only 20 minutes from me. I’m gonna check it out. Thanks for the rec!
[Fatboy74] 10 minutes from me. Never knew about it before now.
[BestTechAdvisor] @Fatboy74: If you want another top-tip, check-out the GC Tool Library. It's not just tools but sporting gear, camping equipment, etc.
[superforever] I didn't this time, but 3 items free delivery always on the banner.
[BestTechAdvisor] Depends on postcode. e.g. I require 5 items or $40 spend
[life is suffering] Everything looks 40% more than usual or when compared to Aexpress
[simb24] fraudulent doesn't criminal anymore in Australia.
[gurgle166] The selection is a lot lower too, some types of items I can't find, others I can find but it's some 0 reviews store so more of a gamble than a comparable Aliexpress etc purchase. My one experience with Haul was with a $5 Haul credit that Amazon gave me.
[life is suffering] Definitely not worth it. It's all cheap at the EOD
[gurgle166] Amazon is really unclear with this sort of thing, I can't find where it says. It really sucks.
[jimojr] Last night, the minimum spend was $20. I added $25 worth of items and tried to check out, but the 40% off code didn’t work. Not sure why.
[gurgle166] Possibly some of the items weren't eligible? Says "eligible items" but nowhere does it say that all Haul items are necessarily eligible. Amazon is really confusing with those sort of thing.
[Lucille Bluth] I wonder when they will finally concede and kill of Haul. I bet in the next 6 months.
[simo1919] can't get it to work, the code can't be applied for haul items on the amazon app.
[Domingo] Why is it that for some stores, generic x% off deals are appropriate but for other stores, it's a requirement for specific bargains to be referenced?
Haul seems like one of those where comments often refer to poor quality products at higher prices than elsewhere
[gurgle166] Unfortunately really does seem like it both from my own experience and what I've read from others. it's super bargain items, the sort you'll find on Aliexpress or Temu or Taobao, at somewhat above bargain prices - probably thanks to Amazon insisting on a sizable cut from sellers still.
[bin555] It's not clear on what's eligible. Give an error saying no eligible.
Too many restrictions
